statusLine.command: input=$(cat); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); short_dir="${dir/#$HOME/~}"; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); repo=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.repo | if . then .owner + "/" + .name else empty end'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty'); session=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_name // empty'); line1=""; [ -n "$model" ] && line1="$(printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$model")"; if [ -n "$used" ] && [ "$used" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then used_k=$((used / 1000)); line1="$line1$(printf '\033[90m/%sk\033[0m' "$used_k")"; fi; line1="$line1 $(printf '\033[1;33m%s\033[0m@\033[1;34m%s\033[0m' "$user" "$host") $(printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m' "$short_dir")"; [ -n "$repo" ] && line1="$line1 $(printf '\033[90m%s\033[0m' "$repo")"; branch=$(git -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && line1="$line1 $(printf '\033[33m%s\033[0m' "$branch")"; [ -n "$session" ] && line1="$line1 $(printf '\033[35m%s\033[0m' "$session")"; echo "$line1"
